criteria.1.1: WHEN an operator adds a Discount_Code with a valid Code_String, Discount_Kind, Value, Minimum_Subtotal, and Expiry_Date, THE Code_Registry SHALL store it so a lookup by that Code_String returns it.
criteria.1.2: IF the Discount_Kind is `percent` and the Value is not an integer from 1 to 50, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the code with a `ValueError`.
criteria.1.3: IF the Discount_Kind is `fixed` and the Value is not an integer from 1 to 10,000,000, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the code with a `ValueError`.
criteria.1.4: IF the Code_String is not 1–20 characters of `A–Z` and `0–9`, or the Minimum_Subtotal is not an integer from 0 to 10,000,000, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the code with a `ValueError`.
criteria.1.5: IF an operator adds a Discount_Code whose Code_String the Code_Registry already holds, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the code with a `ValueError` and keep the stored code unchanged.
criteria.1.6: WHEN `get` is called with a Code_String the Code_Registry does not hold, THE Code_Registry SHALL return `None`.
criteria.1.7: IF the Discount_Kind is not `percent` or `fixed`, or the Expiry_Date is not a `datetime.date`, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the code with a `ValueError` and store nothing.
criteria.2.1: WHEN a shopper applies a Code_String that the Code_Registry holds, Today is on or before its Expiry_Date, and the Subtotal is at least its Minimum_Subtotal, THE Cart SHALL set that Discount_Code as its Applied_Code.
criteria.2.2: IF the applied text is not an exact, case-sensitive match to a Code_String the Code_Registry holds, THEN THE Cart SHALL reject the apply with error `unknown code` and keep its Applied_Code unchanged.
criteria.2.3: IF Today is after the Expiry_Date of the code, THEN THE Cart SHALL reject the apply with error `expired` and keep its Applied_Code unchanged.
criteria.2.4: IF the Subtotal is less than the Minimum_Subtotal of the code, THEN THE Cart SHALL reject the apply with error `below minimum` and keep its Applied_Code unchanged.
criteria.2.5: IF the Cart already has an Applied_Code, THEN THE Cart SHALL reject the apply with error `code already applied` and keep its Applied_Code unchanged.
criteria.2.6: WHEN the Cart rejects an apply, THE Cart SHALL raise a DiscountError whose message is the error text.
criteria.2.7: WHEN an apply fails more than one of 2.2–2.5, THE Cart SHALL raise the first error in this order: `code already applied`, `unknown code`, `expired`, `below minimum`.
criteria.3.1: WHEN a shopper removes the code from a Cart that has an Applied_Code, THE Cart SHALL set its Applied_Code to none.
criteria.3.2: WHEN a shopper removes the code from a Cart that has no Applied_Code, THE Cart SHALL complete without error and keep its Applied_Code as none.
criteria.4.1: WHILE the Applied_Code has Discount_Kind `percent`, THE Cart SHALL compute the Discount as floor(Subtotal × Value ÷ 100) cents.
criteria.4.2: WHILE the Applied_Code has Discount_Kind `fixed`, THE Cart SHALL compute the Discount as the smaller of Value and Subtotal, in cents.
criteria.4.3: WHILE the Cart has no Applied_Code, THE Cart SHALL compute the Discount as 0 cents.
criteria.4.4: THE Cart SHALL compute the Total as Subtotal minus Discount, in cents.
criteria.4.5: WHILE the Subtotal is less than the Minimum_Subtotal of the Applied_Code, THE Cart SHALL compute the Discount as 0 cents.
criteria.4.6: WHILE Today is after the Expiry_Date of the Applied_Code, THE Cart SHALL compute the Discount as 0 cents.
criteria.5.1: WHEN the Shop_API gets `POST /carts/<id>/discount` with body `{"code": <Code_String>}` and the apply succeeds, THE Shop_API SHALL return status 200 with body fields `subtotal_cents`, `discount_cents`, and `total_cents`.
criteria.5.2: IF the apply is rejected with `unknown code`, `expired`, or `below minimum`, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return status 400 with body `{"error": <that error text>}`.
criteria.5.3: IF the apply is rejected with `code already applied`, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return status 409 with body `{"error": "code already applied"}`.
criteria.5.4: WHEN the Shop_API gets `DELETE /carts/<id>/discount` for an existing cart, THE Shop_API SHALL return status 200 with body fields `subtotal_cents`, `discount_cents`, and `total_cents`.
criteria.5.5: WHEN the Shop_API gets `GET /carts/<id>`, THE Shop_API SHALL return the body fields `lines`, `subtotal_cents`, `discount_cents`, `total_cents`, and `code` (the Applied_Code's Code_String or null).
criteria.5.6: IF the `POST /carts/<id>/discount` body has no `code` field or a `code` that is not a string, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return status 400 with body `{"error": "bad code"}`.
